name: Visional, Inc.
summary: Visional, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides human resources platform solutions in Japan. It operates through two segments, HR Tech and Incubation. The company provides BizReach, a membership based job change site that connects talent with companies; BizReach by HRMOS that generates internal resumes and position requirements, and achieving optimal matching between internal talent and positions; HRMOS Talent Management which manages all information related to employees, HR and organizational status; HRMOS Recruitment; HRMOS Attendance, an free cloud attendance management system; HRMOS Expenses, an enpense reimbursement system; Labor Management System, a cloud system that provides …
